work.title: SDE -2
work.description:
Room Spa Mobile App (iOS & Android)

Developed a full-featured on-demand spa service mobile application from scratch, covering both customer and therapist workflows across iOS and Android platforms.

Built end-to-end architecture including booking system, real-time request handling, and user-therapist interaction flows
Implemented therapist discovery and booking with dynamic availability and request acceptance/rejection system
Integrated Google Maps APIs (Directions API & Distance Matrix API) for route optimization and accurate distance/time estimation
Developed live tracking functionality using WebSockets (Socket-based communication) for real-time therapist location updates
Enabled seamless navigation for therapists to reach user locations with turn-by-turn directions
Designed scalable backend interaction with efficient state management and real-time updates
Focused on performance, responsiveness, and smooth cross-platform user experience using React Native
